entries.name: Const SInt 42
entries.description: inline SInt constant — opcode byte is the SType (0x04), payload is the ZigZag VLQ value

entries.name: Const SLong 1000000
entries.description: inline SLong constant — opcode 0x05, payload ZigZag VLQ

entries.name: Const SBoolean true
entries.description: inline SBoolean constant — emitted as OP_TRUE (0x7f) by the special boolean path

entries.name: Const SBoolean false
entries.description: inline SBoolean constant — emitted as OP_FALSE (0x80)

entries.name: Const SColl[SByte] [1,2,3]
entries.description: inline byte-array constant — opcode 0x0e (SColl[SByte]), VLQ-u16 length + raw bytes

entries.name: If(true, 1, 0)
entries.description: opcode 0x95 — If with three Expr children: condition, true-branch, false-branch

entries.name: BinOp Plus(1, 2)
entries.description: opcode 0x9a — Plus arith op on two SInt operands

entries.name: BinOp BinAnd(true, false)
entries.description: opcode 0xed — binary BinAnd (NOT the And-over-collection opcode 0x96)

entries.name: And(Coll[Boolean])
entries.description: opcode 0x96 — And conjunction over a Coll[Boolean] (the BoolConstants variant)

entries.name: Or(Coll[Boolean])
entries.description: opcode 0x97 — Or disjunction over a Coll[Boolean]

entries.name: Xor(Coll[Byte], Coll[Byte])
entries.description: opcode 0x9b — byte-wise XOR of two Coll[SByte]

entries.name: Atleast(2, Coll[SigmaProp])
entries.description: opcode 0x98 — threshold combinator: ≥ N of the SigmaProps in the input collection

entries.name: BitInversion(SLong 1)
entries.description: opcode 0xf1 — bitwise complement on a numeric value

entries.name: ExtractRegisterAs(SELF, R4, SOption[SInt])
entries.description: opcode 0xc6 — SELF.RX[T] (returns SOption[T]); register-id i8 + SType byte

entries.name: Collection Exprs SInt [1,2,3]
entries.description: opcode 0x83 (COLL) — Collection of three SInt expressions; payload is VLQ-u16 length + SType byte + each Expr

entries.name: Collection BoolConstants [T,F,T]
entries.description: opcode 0x85 (COLL_OF_BOOL_CONST) — packed boolean collection; payload is VLQ-u16 length + bit-packed bools

entries.name: ByIndex(MINER_PUBKEY, 0, None)
entries.description: opcode 0xb2 — Coll.apply(index); default branch is Option<Expr> (None here)

entries.name: Tuple(SInt 1, SBoolean true)
entries.description: opcode 0x86 — Tuple of mixed types; payload is u8 length + each Expr

entries.name: SelectField(Tuple, 1)
entries.description: opcode 0x8c — tuple field selector; field index is 1-based u8

entries.name: BoolToSigmaProp(true)
entries.description: opcode 0xd1 — wrap an SBoolean into an SSigmaProp

entries.name: SigmaPropBytes(ProveDlog)
entries.description: opcode 0xd0 — serialized bytes of a SigmaProp value

entries.name: SigmaAnd([ProveDlog])
entries.description: opcode 0xea — AND conjunction over a non-empty list of SigmaProps

entries.name: SigmaOr([ProveDlog])
entries.description: opcode 0xeb — OR conjunction over a non-empty list of SigmaProps

entries.name: Upcast(SInt 1, SLong)
entries.description: opcode 0x7e — numeric widening; target SType follows the opcode

entries.name: SubstConstants(script, [0], [42])
entries.description: opcode 0x74 — substitute constants in a serialized script. Three Expr children: script bytes, positions, new values.

entries.name: DeserializeContext(SInt, varId=1)
entries.description: opcode 0xd4 — type byte + u8 varId; inlines script from context extension at the given id

entries.name: DeserializeRegister(SInt, R4, None)
entries.description: opcode 0xd5 — type byte + u8 register-id + Option<default>

entries.name: MultiplyGroup(GROUP_GENERATOR, GROUP_GENERATOR)
entries.description: opcode 0xa0 — group multiplication of two SGroupElement operands

entries.name: XorOf(Coll[Boolean])
entries.description: opcode 0xff — XOR of all booleans in the collection

entries.name: GetVar[SInt](1)
entries.description: opcode 0xe3 — context-variable lookup; payload is u8 varId + SType byte

entries.name: FuncValue((x:Int) => x + 1)
entries.description: opcode 0xd9 — user function literal: list of args (id, tpe) + body Expr

entries.name: Apply(FuncValue, [Int 7])
entries.description: opcode 0xda — function application: callee Expr + arg list
